assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated industrial building asset for the fictional post-apocalyptic Khan empire's Imperial Arsenal focus. A compact rugged arms-factory workshop, three-quarter front-left view, dark weathered brick and reinforced concrete, a recognizable stepped sawtooth factory roof, one short square exhaust chimney, tall dirty factory windows with restrained warm amber light, wide closed dark steel loading doors, a few large external pipes. Industrial production, not a fortress or palace. Repaired sheet metal details, charcoal metal with very subtle burgundy door trim. Sober realistic painted military concept-art aesthetic with warm key light and cool edge highlights, bold compact silhouette readable in a small HOI4 icon. Entire building visible with complete roof and small foundation, generous transparent margins. No signs, text, badges, logos, flags, people, vehicles, guns, loose crates, foreground objects, ground slab, sky, scenery, smoke cloud or opaque glow. One building only on genuine transparent alpha, including gaps, no vignette.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated full-body armorer character for a fictional post-apocalyptic Khan empire military factory. Older broad-shouldered male craftsman with short graying hair and a trimmed mustache, round protective goggles pushed up on forehead. Worn charcoal-green work shirt with sleeves rolled up, modest burgundy neck scarf, heavy brown leather smith apron, charcoal trousers, brown work boots. Holds ONE COMPLETE finished AKM Kalashnikov horizontally in both hands across waist, wooden stock and wooden foregrip, curved magazine, barrel pointing screen-left and angled slightly down. He is inspecting a finished rifle, no disassembled weapon, no instructions or schematic. Rifle and hands clear and anatomically coherent, right hand at grip and left supporting foregrip, no fingers merging with metal. Calm focused expression, natural three-quarter standing pose. Full body and both boots completely visible, clear transparent margin. Detailed realistic painterly military concept art, dusty leather and cloth, warm key and cool rim, restrained charcoal/brown/burgundy palette. NO workbench, factory, crates, other people, floor, backdrop, scene, lettering, logo or halo. Single character cutout on true transparent alpha.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated military logistics prop for a fictional post-apocalyptic imperial arsenal: a low open sturdy wooden shipping crate containing three completed AKM-pattern rifles lying neatly parallel in fitted slots, seen from slightly above in three-quarter view. Recognizable wooden rifle furniture and dark metal receivers, no disassembly, no cutaway or technical diagram. Worn dark olive wooden crate exterior, warm bare wood interior, dark metal reinforced corners and two practical handles. Hinged lid opened behind the crate at roughly 70 degrees, showing plain wood without text. Compact wide silhouette, complete corners and every object fully within canvas. Realistically painted military concept art, credible materials, warm highlights, restrained charcoal-green, brown and burgundy-small-hardware palette, readable at small icon size. No ammunition scattered outside, no people, hands, factory, table, ground, scenery, typography, stencils, symbols, flags, badges or extra crates. Exactly one open crate with its rifles, isolated on genuine transparent alpha, clean cutout edges, no surrounding shadow or glow.

composition_preview_prompt: Use case: compositing. Combine these three provided assets into one proposed finished HOI4 focus artwork for Imperial Arsenal. Image1 the industrial factory building: preserve its sawtooth roof, chimney, warm windows, brick and concrete. Image2 the armorer: preserve his exact identity, brown apron, burgundy scarf, full body and finished AKM in his hands. Image3 the open rifle shipping crate: preserve its form and contents. Compact approximately square triangular collage, transparent exterior. Factory is back layer occupying upper-left and center, all its roof silhouette visible. The armorer stands large at right foreground, head at roughly upper quarter, both boots within canvas, rifle and hands unobscured. Open rifle crate at lower-left foreground, smaller than the man's torso plus legs but large enough to recognize the three parallel rifles, no overlap hiding his hands. Scale as a deliberate focus-icon collage rather than literal real-world proportions. Strong three principal shapes, coherent warm amber light and cool edge highlights, charcoal/brown/burgundy palette, realistic painted military concept art matching the references. Keep all asset extremities inside frame with 5 percent clear margin. No new objects, no people beyond this one, no workbench or giant ground slab, no smoke, no sky, no backdrop, no vignette, no opaque halo, no emblems, no frame, no text. Genuine transparent alpha around and between assets. One complete composition, not a contact sheet or multiple variants.
